verdict.rationale: Inspecting ranking scores or explanations is a fair question for a search engine, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents an explain API, per-hit scores or score breakdowns. It covers only hybrid search, RRF rank fusion and reranking, which concern how results are ranked rather than inspecting why they ranked where they did.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can inspect ranking scores or explanations to understand exactly why a result ranked where it did
